spans.label: crate and plonky2 imports
spans.note: Every imported gadget (Poseidon/keccak hashing, Merkle proofs, falcon_sig::agg_list, poseidon_sig::list, RegevPk, the plonky2 CircuitBuilder API) enters the model only as an opaque callback field of Env. Handwritten local semantics; no source/compiler refinement.

spans.label: UpdateUserTreeError variants
spans.note: The model's fault type keeps a category plus a location string; the source's formatted messages are not reproduced verbatim.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputs fields
spans.note: Field-for-field; the doc comments describing the bp_sig_chain accumulator are the boundary text carried into the module header.

spans.label: UpdateUserTree witness fields
spans.note: The ten parallel per-block-slot vectors are collapsed into one list of Slot records; the ten-way length gate becomes one length check. This is a simplification of error SHAPE, not of behaviour.

spans.label: channel_leaf_member_root: the member root is preserved
spans.note: The retired direct-MSU tombstone returns the previous root unchanged; the model bakes that into the leaf transition.

spans.label: validate_member_set_delta (cfg(feature = "deprecated-msu"), deprecated)
spans.note: A feature-gated, deprecated tombstone for the retired direct member-set update. Not compiled in the release build and not modelled; the release refusal of the reserved action tag IS modelled (see the 1192-1202 span).

spans.label: impl header and doc comment
spans.note: No executable content.

spans.label: check_n_of_n_witness: the native N-of-N witness restatement
spans.note: Check order and error precedence follow the source. No signature is verified here, natively or in-circuit; the recomputed member root, the occupancy bounds and the Regev digest bind are what is checked.

spans.label: to_public_inputs (the validating mirror prove runs)
spans.note: Thin wrapper over compute_public_inputs with strict = true.

spans.label: to_public_inputs_unchecked (cfg(test)): the same computation, no cross-checks
spans.note: Source-gated on #[cfg(test)] but modelled because the source states a behavioural claim about it, which the linked theorem proves for the model.

spans.label: length gates, block hash chain, member_leaves width, retired MSU wire
spans.note: Block::hash_with_prev_hash is the opaque Env.blockHash callback; its key_ids length gate is modelled as a separate check.

spans.label: running root and chain init; the folded (digest, signer_count, pk_list_digest) statement
spans.note: signing_digest, agg_pk_list_digest and agg_list_leaf are opaque callbacks; the model reproduces only that the digest takes channel_id and h2_tag from THIS block and that the pk list covers all MAX_SIG_CLUSTER slots.

spans.label: the per-block-slot loop: openings, tx class rules, chain fold, leaf transition
spans.note: Merkle verify/get_root are the opaque Env.merkleRoot callback, so nothing here is a Merkle soundness claim. The tx class match, the source-channel bind and the MemberSetUpdate refusal are modelled exactly; destination_channel_id, tx_hash, seal and payload_hash are read by nothing.

spans.label: the returned public inputs
spans.note: The account root is recomputed by the loop and never read from a proof; the linked theorems show it is a pure fold that cannot see the channel-state fields.

spans.label: UPDATE_ACCOUNT_PUBLIC_INPUTS_LEN
spans.note: Pinned as literals with the same arithmetic as the source constant.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputs::to_u64_vec
spans.note: Field order reproduced exactly; U64::to_u64_vec becomes the two-limb split.

spans.label: commitment(): Poseidon over the public-input words
spans.note: PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64 is not modelled; no hash property is claimed anywhere.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputs::from_u64_slice
spans.note: Length gate first, then BlockNumber::new, then the cursor walk in source field order, with the u32-range gate of U32LimbTrait::from_u64_slice and the length-only gate of PoseidonHashOut::from_u64_slice.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputsTarget fields
spans.note: The model does not distinguish a plonky2 Target from its value; only the field layout is shared.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputsTarget::new (virtual targets and range checks)
spans.note: Builder allocation and range-check lowering are not modelled.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputsTarget::to_vec (the registered public-input order)
spans.note: Same order as to_u64_vec; this is the order register_public_inputs publishes.

spans.label: in-circuit commitment()
spans.note: In-circuit Poseidon is not modelled.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputsTarget::from_slice
spans.note: Only the field ORDER is shared with the model; the target decoder's assert_eq on length and its absence of canonicity checks are not modelled.

spans.label: set_witness (witness-write effects)
spans.note: Native witness-writing effects are outside the model.

spans.label: UpdateUserPublicInputsTarget::select
spans.note: plonky2 select lowering is a boundary; the model reads select as an if/then/else on the boolean.

spans.label: UpdateUserTreeTarget fields
spans.note: tx_class and channel-action kind are free field elements in the circuit witness, not Rust enums - the model keeps that distinction.

spans.label: UpdateUserTreeTarget::new prologue (target allocation, range checks, block hash chain)
spans.note: Builder allocation, the TX_TREE_HEIGHT index range checks and the in-circuit keccak block hash are opaque; only the tree-height constants are pinned.

spans.label: the IMCH signing digest: channel_id and h2_tag come from THIS block
spans.note: The digest itself is an opaque callback; what is modelled is that its channel id and h2_tag are the block's own targets, so a foreign or stale digest is a different value.

spans.label: the signer set: thermometer, member leaves, recomputed root, folded statement
spans.note: compute_member_tree_root, agg_pk_list_digest and agg_list_leaf are shared opaque gadgets; the model calls the same callbacks the native mirror uses.

spans.label: prev_bp_sig_chain, the computed any_sign flag, Regev digest constants
spans.note: any_sign is COMPUTED from the per-slot should_update flags, never witnessed; the model defines it that way.

spans.label: per-slot gates: account opening, tx binding, nonce, class rules, action bind, MSU refusal, send opening, leaf update
spans.note: One CircuitGates field per source connection, on an ARBITRARY satisfying witness. conditional_assert_eq / is_equal / select / assert_zero are read as their boolean and integer relations; that lowering is a boundary.

spans.label: N-of-N member-set binding and the single chain fold
spans.note: The model reproduces the root connect, the active-slot requirement, the Regev digest bind and the fold. It does NOT claim any signature exists: the aggregate-list proof that discharges the folded statement lives in another circuit and is an undischarged boundary here.

spans.label: block-level signer-set well-formedness gated on any_sign
spans.note: The 2..=MAX_SIG_CLUSTER range check and the two-directional occupancy gates, both conditioned on the computed any_sign.

spans.label: public input assembly and the returned target struct
spans.note: The public-input wiring is a CircuitGates field per output; the example witness makes the whole gate system non-vacuous.

spans.label: UpdateUserTreeTarget::set_witness
spans.note: Witness-writing effects, including the member_leaves length assert and the deliberately short Regev zip, are outside the model.

spans.label: UpdateUserCircuitError
spans.note: Modelled loosely as the same fault type; the proving failure variant has no model counterpart.

spans.label: UpdateUserCircuit: build, prove, prove_with_public_inputs
spans.note: Circuit building and proving are opaque. The model records only that prove runs the STRICT native mirror first and that the pub(crate) test entry point bypasses it.

spans.label: #[cfg(test)] module: fixtures, positive and negative cases
spans.note: Read but not translated. The negative cases pin in-circuit constraints via to_public_inputs_unchecked; the model states the corresponding facts directly as theorems instead.

boundaries.name: merkleRoot
boundaries.obligation: Channel-, send-, tx- and channel-action Merkle path folds (proof.verify / get_root) are an opaque callback. No injectivity, binding or Merkle soundness property is assumed or proved; 'the witnessed leaf is the leaf at that index' rests on collision resistance of the unmodelled hash.

boundaries.name: channelLeafHash / sendLeafHash / txV2Hash / txV2HashT / actionHash / actionHashT / memberLeafHash
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon leaf hashing (Leafable::hash) is opaque; the model never assumes distinct leaves have distinct hashes.

boundaries.name: memberTreeRoot
boundaries.obligation: compute_member_tree_root (in-circuit) and MemberTree::push/get_root (native) are the SAME opaque callback in the model. Their agreement, and the claim that a duplicate pk_g is unrepresentable under the real Poseidon tree, are undischarged premises.

boundaries.name: blockHash
boundaries.obligation: Block::hash_with_prev_hash (solidity_keccak256 over prev || channel_id || timestamp || key_ids || tx_tree_root || deposit_hash_chain || channel_reg_hash_chain) and its in-circuit twin are opaque and are not proved to agree.

boundaries.name: signingDigest
boundaries.obligation: ChannelStateMessageFields::signing_digest is opaque. Its 139-limb preimage layout is modelled in Zkp.Implementation.BlockMessages, which is built but NOT a registered current module and is therefore deliberately not imported here; the interface is named, not consumed.

boundaries.name: aggPkListDigest / aggListLeaf
boundaries.obligation: falcon_sig::agg_list gadgets are opaque. The folded tuple is reproduced structurally; nothing here proves that any Falcon signature exists, nor that signer_count counts distinct signers.

boundaries.name: chainStep
boundaries.obligation: poseidon_sig::list::list_chain_step is opaque. The order-sensitivity and collision resistance of the accumulator are assumed, not proved.

boundaries.name: aggregate-list recursive proof
boundaries.obligation: The statement folded into bp_sig_chain is discharged by a recursive aggregate-list proof consumed by the validity circuit, not by this file. Proof soundness and the C == final.bp_sig_chain check are entirely outside this model.

boundaries.name: BP signature
boundaries.obligation: No block-producer signature is verified in this source file or in this model. Whatever authorises the block producer is enforced elsewhere (block posting / channel-reg chain), and is an undischarged premise here.

boundaries.name: regevDigestOfCoeffs
boundaries.obligation: RegevPk::poseidon_digest and its in-circuit recompute over [IMRP, n, a.., b..] are one opaque callback; only the bp slot's digest is bound, the other MAX_SIG_CLUSTER-1 slots' digests ride on the member-root connect (design 'cost trap').

boundaries.name: reduceToHashOut / bytes32OfHash / hashOfBytes32Native / hashOfBytes32Target
boundaries.obligation: Bytes32 <-> PoseidonHashOut repacking. The native try_into CAN fail on a non-canonical value while the in-circuit to_hash_out is a total repack; the model records the asymmetry but proves nothing about it.

boundaries.name: field lowering
boundaries.obligation: is_equal, not, and, or, select, conditional_assert_eq, assert_zero, range_check, is_zero and lt_const_threshold are read as boolean and integer relations over Nat. Goldilocks field arithmetic, wraparound and the arithmetisation of these gadgets are not modelled.

boundaries.name: native/target refinement
boundaries.obligation: The native mirror and the circuit are two independent Lean objects. Nothing proves the Rust native path and the plonky2 constraint system agree, nor that either matches this model.

boundaries.name: single-fold soundness
boundaries.obligation: The source itself flags that bp_sig_chain folds at most one statement per block and ASSUMES exactly one channel-leaf transition per block. The model reproduces the per-slot fold but does not prove that at most one slot can update; that rests on the unmodelled Merkle binding of the running root at index channel_id.

boundaries.name: fund accounting
boundaries.obligation: No fund quantity exists in the channel-tree leaf, so this file enforces NO conservation of channel funds across a block, no cross-channel debit/credit pairing, and no destination-channel credit. Those obligations belong entirely to other circuits (the channel state-update verifier and the close/settlement path) and are undischarged here.

boundaries.name: witness-write and proving effects
boundaries.obligation: set_witness, builder.build and data.prove are opaque; completeness of the honest prover path is not modelled.
